key_insight: The paper introduces a new R package for non-negative matrix factorization and benchmarks it against two existing R implementations using real-world data.
engineering_relevance: It helps practitioners choose an NMF package based on practical tradeoffs in speed, convergence, accuracy, memory use, and factorization stability.
method: Built a new R package for NMF analysis.
Compared it with two widely used R NMF packages under a common experimental setup.
Evaluated computational efficiency, convergence behavior, reconstruction accuracy, memory usage, and stability.
evidence_signal: The comparison uses real-world datasets rather than simulations to better capture noise, heterogeneity, and practical complexity.
watch_item: Results may depend on dataset characteristics and implementation details, so package choice should still be validated on the target application.
paper_title: Non--negative matrix factorization using the \textit{R} package \textsf{nnmf}
